strategy.desc: The original corporate bitcoin treasury. It buys bitcoin with money raised from common stock, convertible notes and preferred shares (STRC, STRF, STRK, STRD, STRE).

strive.desc: Bitcoin treasury company that funds purchases partly through SATA, its variable-rate preferred stock paid daily.

twenty-one-capital.desc: Bitcoin-focused company led by Jack Mallers that went public holding a large bitcoin balance.

metaplanet.desc: Tokyo-listed company that made bitcoin its main treasury asset in 2024.

mara.desc: One of the largest US bitcoin miners; keeps mined and purchased bitcoin on its balance sheet.

bullish.desc: Institutional digital-asset exchange operator that holds bitcoin on its balance sheet.

spacex.desc: Space launch and Starlink satellite-internet company with bitcoin on its balance sheet.

coinbase.desc: Largest US crypto exchange; holds bitcoin as a corporate investment, separate from customer assets.

cleanspark.desc: US bitcoin miner that keeps part of the bitcoin it mines.

trump-media.desc: Parent of Truth Social; added bitcoin to its treasury in 2025.

tesla.desc: Electric-vehicle maker that bought bitcoin in 2021 and still holds part of it.

riot.desc: US bitcoin miner with large operations in Texas.

hut-8-mining-corp.desc: North American bitcoin miner and energy-infrastructure company.

block.desc: Payments company behind Square and Cash App; has held bitcoin since 2020.

american-bitcoin-corp.desc: Bitcoin mining and accumulation company affiliated with Hut 8.

gd-culture-group.desc: Small-cap company that moved to a bitcoin treasury strategy in 2025.

galaxy-digital-holdings.desc: Crypto financial-services and data-center company led by Mike Novogratz.

next-technology-holding-inc.desc: Small-cap technology company holding bitcoin as its main treasury asset.

gemini-space-station-inc.desc: Crypto exchange founded by Cameron and Tyler Winklevoss; listed in 2025.

procap-financial.desc: Bitcoin-focused financial company listed as SVIA.
